name: westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_session_mode_sel_change
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDialog::OnSessionModeComboSelChange stores the selected session-mode kind, updates the value/time label and edit enable state, then refreshes the encoded query.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x43ee80 verifies CB_GETCURSEL, CB_GETITEMDATA, assignment to m_querySessionModeKind, message id 0x3040 plus disabling m_queryValueOrTimeEdit when kind equals 2, message id 0x3041 plus enabling that edit otherwise, and a call to UpdateSessionListQueryFromControls in both branches.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_session_mode_sel_change_smoke uses a real combo box with item data, patched MFC UI calls, zLoc, and the real encoded-query update path to verify both branches, label control id 1167, enable state, message ids, and refresh call.
